_ghi_chu: English names and descriptions for data/video-phu.json (same ids and numbers). Articles: data/en/bai/<file>.json.

5.1.tieu_de: How radar helps cars see through fog
5.1.mo_ta: Thick fog scatters LiDAR's laser, so a car needs a second eye: radar, which measures both distance and speed.

5.2.tieu_de: How AI reads red lights and road signs with a camera
5.2.mo_ta: Radar and LiDAR can't tell whether a light is red or green. Only a camera sees color and text, and AI reads the image in three steps.

5.3.tieu_de: LiDAR, radar or camera: which is best?
5.3.mo_ta: The three eyes compete in six events: distance, speed, color and text, night, fog and rain, and price. Each one is good at something.

5.4.tieu_de: Sensor fusion: how AI combines LiDAR, radar and camera
5.4.mo_ta: Each eye is only partly sure. Combining the three clues, called sensor fusion, beats even the best single eye.

5.5.tieu_de: What warehouse robots, forklifts and traffic lights see with
5.5.mo_ta: Warehouse robots, self-driving forklifts, intersection cameras and speed guns: each job picks a different eye.

5.6.tieu_de: Crop-spraying drones, self-driving tractors, site scans
5.6.mo_ta: Spraying drones follow the field, self-driving tractors use stereo cameras, and LiDAR scans buildings under construction.

5.7.tieu_de: Radar that detects a fall without a camera
5.7.mo_ta: Radar detects falls and counts breaths without filming anyone's face. The last part sums up four questions for picking the right eye.

69.1.tieu_de: Claude clicks and types in Chrome: a real run from start to finish
69.1.mo_ta: Install Claude in Chrome, have it read and compare web pages, then let it click and type its way through filling a spreadsheet.

69.2.tieu_de: Giving Claude 7,000 rows of Excel: it caught a double-count
69.2.mo_ta: Hand Claude a 7,341-row sales log right inside Excel: it catches a double-counted total, summarizes by item and builds a formula-based forecast.

69.3.tieu_de: From Excel numbers to 5 meeting slides, no retyping
69.3.mo_ta: Claude builds five meeting slides from the Excel results, with real editable PowerPoint charts, and you still do the final check.
